# onchain_tempo v0.7.0 - Table of Contents

> Tempo blockchain primitives for Elixir — 0x76 transactions, TIP-20 tokens, RPC broadcasting, and event parsing. Built on onchain.

## Modules

- [Onchain.Tempo.Faucet](https://onchain-tempo.hexdocs.pm/Onchain.Tempo.Faucet.md): Moderato testnet faucet — wraps the non-standard `tempo_fundAddress` JSON-RPC.
- [Onchain.Tempo.RPC](https://onchain-tempo.hexdocs.pm/Onchain.Tempo.RPC.md): Tempo-specific JSON-RPC operations — transaction broadcast and receipt fetching.
- [Onchain.Tempo.TIP20](https://onchain-tempo.hexdocs.pm/Onchain.Tempo.TIP20.md): TIP-20 token function selectors, ABI calldata encoders, and Tempo constants.
- [Onchain.Tempo.Transaction](https://onchain-tempo.hexdocs.pm/Onchain.Tempo.Transaction.md): Tempo Transaction (EIP-2718 type 0x76) — RLP deserialization, payment call
matching, and fee payer co-signing (0x78 domain).
- [Onchain.Tempo.Transaction.Builder](https://onchain-tempo.hexdocs.pm/Onchain.Tempo.Transaction.Builder.md): Builds and signs Tempo Transactions (EIP-2718 type 0x76).
- [Onchain.Tempo.Transfer](https://onchain-tempo.hexdocs.pm/Onchain.Tempo.Transfer.md): Tempo-specific `TransferWithMemo` event log parsing.
- [OnchainTempo](https://onchain-tempo.hexdocs.pm/OnchainTempo.md): Tempo blockchain primitives for Elixir.
